reviews.title: No call, no email, BS company!!!
reviews.text: This company went out of business without a call, email or any other notification. If I wouldn't of checked prior to our trip, we would have been stuck in Roatan for at least one day before being able to continue on. One email and I would not have been so upset.
reviews.author: Terry H

reviews.title: HORRIBLE!!!!
reviews.text: Booked (and PAID) for flight and extra baggage fees in March 2018 for our trip in September 2018; arrived to Roatan, and upon arrival tried to verify our flight for the following week and time, only to find out they are no longer in business??!!!! No call, no cancellation, no nothing....I guess no refund either since there is no contact info $600+ they stole from me. NOT GOOD HUMAN PRACTICE.
reviews.author: nhug12018

reviews.title: I booked with Island Air in early March, they canceled flight 22 hours before departure, no refund.
reviews.text: I booked with Island Air in early March, 2018 for a flight in early June. They confirmed the flight and asked for payment in early March. They then canceled the flight 22 hours before departure and despite their assurance that they would refund me, they haven't done so.
reviews.author: cjlthehappytraveler

reviews.title: The most horrible experience I have ever had dealing with a company
reviews.text: I like to consider myself a fairly experienced and frequent flyer and never in my life have I had something like this happen. Our flight from Chicago into Honolulu was late. After missing the bus that brings you to the other side of the airport, we caught the next one and ran to where our next flight was leaving. Sorry...American Airlines booked us on a flight that was cancelled months ago. Well actually PRICELINE did. So while we were trying to get to Kona with about 2,500 other athletes and their families for the Ironman World Championships...we waiting to see if we could be wait listed on the next flight and/or booked on a separate flight. After being assured that the situation was being handled...and waiting for over an hour...people that had just come and had similar issues were being bumped before us! They tried to compensate us by giving us food and beverage vouchers that we had no time to use and then booked us on a flight to HILO on the other side of the island. Fine. We took our tickets and went back to the other side of the airport and waited. At this point we are going on 24 hours of travel with the time change. As our flight is boarding and we stand in line we hand our tickets to the attendant who says and I quote "Oh I'm so sorry, these are not tickets. Where did you come from?" So we tell her the story and she says, "They must not have wanted to tell you the flight was booked." ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! Now I'm even more flabbergasted. HOW DOES THIS HAPPEN?! So we f
reviews.author: Amanda C

reviews.title: Disappointed with their service.
reviews.text: We book flights back in May to use Island Air between Islands in January, and the day we arrived to check in our flight. We found out that they ceased all operations and they did not email us or let us know the changes. So without them letting us know about the changes, they costed us an extra 1000$ for not letting their customers know ahead of the time the situation. Terrible airline.
reviews.author: Maleesha

reviews.title: Better late than Never
reviews.text: This airline has the ability to be great however it is almost like they don’t want to succeed. After 2 members of our party of 6 being bumped on the first leg of our flight, we switched to another airline and Island allowed this without penalty. The second leg of our trip was over an hour late after Island Air blaming bad weather which I had only checked 5 mins earlier and announced to our group what a great weather day we were going to have at our destination. However they do the little things that make ur trip memorable ie. all ground crew waving goodbye and hello as you depart and arrive. The staff are incredibly helpful and friendly. The plane a q400 was an amazing ride and appeared almost brand new. I hope the best for this airline in spite of themselves
reviews.author: Stu C

reviews.title: Sweet airline...
reviews.text: Another fine airline. No issues, no problems. Would use them again. And remember you are flying to Paradise. It's all good.
reviews.author: TheDude23112

reviews.title: helpful
reviews.text: staff extremely helpful, kind, cheerful, & held flight for us to make the connection. They rebooked us when they did not need to. Great service.
reviews.author: Wild Q

reviews.title: Great short flight
reviews.text: I hate flying! No, I really do. I’ve taken Amtrak from Oregon to NY just to avoid flying! Some of it is fear of crashing and most of it is claustrophobia. I’d be fine being the pilot, I just don’t like sitting in the back while somebody else is at the controls. Every once I. A while there is no other option such as Hawaii. So my daughter was getting married and we needed to go to Hawaii. So we took the aforementioned Amtrak from LA to Vancouver BC, then took a cruise to Hawaii. That’s the good news. The bad news is there is no cruise coming back until April, 6 months later! Sheesh. The other bad news is the ferry from Oahu to Maui no longer runs. So Island hopping via airplane is our only choice. We chose Island Air and it was very nice. I’d certainly fly Island Air again!
reviews.author: Dr. Tim

reviews.title: Sorry to see such good people go
reviews.text: We were one of the lucky ones to be on one the last flights on this Hawaii inter island airline before they shut down. Even though they were losing their jobs and their future was in jeopardy every employee exhibited class and grace. They were overwhelmingly appreciative of their customers and you could see they all thought of each other as family (ohana). Even though we had a problem with United transferring our bag to them and the bags missing our flight, Kammy came through and got the bag delivered to our hotel that night. I would recommend these employees to any other airline looking for quality customer oriented employees.
reviews.author: Paulta2016

reviews.title: Island Air files for bankruptcy las passenger flight 11/11/71 end of day.
reviews.text: It is a sad day, Island Air has fallen way to bankruptcy and will cease flying and the end of today. Hawaiian air will allow Island Air passengers with unrefundable tickets to fly stand by, only . Or $71.00 for a confirmed seat that is lower than the regular fare.
reviews.author: Clyde T

reviews.title: For a slow paced inter island flight with good views
reviews.text: Don't let jet traffic wiz you by beautify views of the shore and the Island on a turbo prop 29 passenger aircraft. Easy check in and ability to catch other connection flights in or out of Honolulu and other select islands.
reviews.author: Clyde T

reviews.title: Stay away unless you wanna get robbed.
reviews.text: As the other passengers have addressed it, they make your tiny carryon that complies with the most of the other airlines policy check in and charge $25 extra per bag if it exceeds 16lb. 16lb is really easy to exceed even if all you have is just clothes. What’s worse for us was that this policy is followed by only some dumb employees of this sketchy airline. It was the same bags and same weight on the way to Maui and they were fine. Only this dumb young woman charged us $50 for both of our carryons and made us check them in. What kind of policy is truly for safety if it exists only to make this failing scammy airline rich and is enforced randomly?! Go with the Hawaiian Airlines. Their weight limit is 25lb which is more reasonable and we would not have had to pay $50 and then go through the baggage claim for no reason.
reviews.author: Jay F

reviews.title: Weigh your carry on luggage
reviews.text: Got a real surprise today a check in when we were told that our carry on luggage has to be less 16 lbs or they charge $25 and it must be checked regardless of size. Would have been a better deal to fly Hawaiian air. Hidden way to drive profit, I don't like to be surprized!
reviews.author: Lee C

reviews.title: Personal Service
reviews.text: Island Air is in the process of switching web platforms. This was the first leg of my trip connecting to United in Honolulu. United would not let me check in on the United site. I had to check in with Island Air. Because the website was being upgraded, I could not check in on-line. I called Island Air and was cared for by an unbelievably helpful person who sent an e-mail to the Island Air ticket counter at KOA. They managed to check me through to HNL and both of my subsequent United flights. I requested a window seat and it was provided. I promptly received an e-mail confirmation that the check-in had been completed. This saved me an early trip to the airport. I can't say how helpful and pleasant the Island Air representative was. But this seems to be their style. Both the flight attendants and pilot seemed to really care that I was a passenger. This is an experience I rarely encounter with big carriers. I look forward to my next flight on Island Air. Way better approach to customer service than their competitor for inter-island flights in Hawaii.
reviews.author: David W

reviews.title: What terrible service - even before we are due to fly.
reviews.text: What terrible service - even before we are due to fly. Having booked flights several weeks ago to fly between islands in a week's time we received notice that the schedule flight had been cancelled and rescheduled approximately 2 hours later. Since this did not suit our holiday arrangements we tried contacting to cancel the booking and to request a full refund. Our email of Wednesday 25th has gone unanswered so we again tried calling Friday 28th October - after 5 mins on the automated call line we were then advised of a predicted wait time of over 1 hr. Since I was trying to cancel bookings and arrange a full refund being stuck with an international call to Hawaii from the UK made little sense - although no doubt the telephone company would have been pleased with the extra revenue. Seeking an alternative way to communicate through social media it became evident why the bookings are in turmoil and why we are unable to contact the company - they have filed for emergency Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection following a recent lawsuit. On that basis I assume my money is intended to prop them up for a few more micro minutes. You've been warned!!
reviews.author: Escape-overseas

reviews.title: Cancelled Flights for their Profit
reviews.text: Three days before the trip, they called to tell me that the flights (both ways) have been cancelled, and informed me (not ask and without apologies) that I was put on later for the first flight and earlier for the second flight. I can only imagine that they are doing this to cancel empty flights to maximize their profits. But what about customers who planned their trip months ahead (by the way, I had to coordinate the flights to meet other parties at the airport) and now who needs to change their schedules? Now I will be waiting for 5 hours at the airport. The customer representative was so rude: no sorry or let me see what I can do to accommodate. DO NOT USE THIS AIRLINE. WHAT A JOKE.
reviews.author: oc1004

reviews.title: 9 hours wait and 5 boarding passes
reviews.text: What a disaster. After flying 13 hours from Australia we were informed at the Island Air check-in counter that we had been put on a 7.30pm flight. Our original flight was scheduled for 1.22pm. After complaining about the wait after such a long flight they issued boarding passes for the next flight to Kauai but couldn't guarantee we would get a place. We of course had no hope in hell of getting on the next flight because there were a large number of other people on standby. This game of issuing boarding passes and promises went on until after 9pm. They also threw in a story about Qantas not having passed on the payment for the flight th Kauai. I think the reality was they didn't have enough planes to cover all the people and bikes coming in for the Ironman and didn't cut off bookings when the planes were full, so had to divert planes to Kona. 9 very long hours, no food and only access to Starbucks. They finally agreed at about 8 pm to give us vouchers and access to the International terminal for food...only to find one shop selling noodles open. NEVER EVER AGAIN will I fly Island Air.
reviews.author: ChrissyZ

reviews.title: Excellent flight, ground gripe with common rules between airlines
reviews.text: We were less than 20minutes in the air. One of the flight attendants took to the mic to explain to the passengers what we were seeing on our left and right sides. It felt like we were on a tour and we greatly appreciated it. Also, they gave us taro roots cookie and some exotic fruit juice. For a flight that short it was a pleasant surprise. On the ground, before the flight they seemed to have had some problems with flight sharing with United Airlines - they could not find us in the system and we had to wait longer before our boarding passes were printed. Also, their carry-on luggage allowance was lower (6kg) which was a disappointment - we had to check-in our small carry-on suitcases (for $25 each), which we specifically bought for this flight.
reviews.author: northern_prairie

reviews.title: We always choose Island Air for Inter-island flights
reviews.text: Island air has been out Go-to for a year now for our inter-island flights. Their flight prices are half of Hawaiian Airlines. Had to fly to Honolulu for exams June 2017, got done early there & they got us on an earlier flight home with no problem, no extra cost (Hawaiian air charges to change flights). Same thing happened Sept 2017. We were returning from China, and they got us on the next flight HNL to Lihue within the hour. My husband takes Island air for business Island hops to HNL. The second most convenient part about this airline is they have their own security check that is not near Hawaiian Air's security check cluster. It takes <5 mins to get through, and Hawaiian Air security check lines are out the door and snake around & you worry if you're going to make your flight (this has happened many times with us). We only choose Hawaiian Air to get to the mainland bc that is what sets us apart from choosing between the two. My family is visiting for Christmas 2017 and we plan to go to Maui for a weekend. Flights Are $100-120/person on island air compared to $200-220 on Hawaiian. *Island Air: please always stay this way!*
reviews.author: LaLa313

reviews.title: Happy with everything except...
reviews.text: We were never informed that our connecting flight was cancelled or delayed or something until we came to the airport. They should have informed us before that. They offered us free meal or earlier flight with the other airline and in the end, we were lucky because we came to our destination earlier than expected. But it could have turned the other way. Flights were on time.
reviews.author: Alen S

reviews.title: Fantastic option!!
reviews.text: Flew this airline into Kona, Big Island as it was much cheaper than Hawaiian Airlines, though it only went to Kona & not Hilo. Great trip! No problems whatsoever...little delayed returning, but overall, great for the price. Service was friendly and proficient. Great alternative. Thanks Island Air!!
reviews.author: Talwag5

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Worst customer service. Flight cancelled and spend 1.5 hours waiting for them to print a ticket. People helping clearly didn't care. Never will book a ticket through island air again.
reviews.author: Leslie G

reviews.title: Short flight
reviews.text: We took Island Air to jump to another island. Check in at the airport. We had only hand luggage, few pounds more but without any extra charge. At the airport - free coffe, cookies and newspaper. During the flight free water or fruit drink. Price was okay for 2 person. For me good choice.
reviews.author: Piotr D

reviews.title: Island Hop
reviews.text: Could not checkin on line and did this at counter. Easy to accomplish and nice waiting area. On time takeoff and landing. Accomplished crew got juice to all in short time. Would do this again
reviews.author: Perkadventures

reviews.title: OVERCHARGED MY ACCT $1300
reviews.text: I travel a lot on Island Air because I have a family of 8, and traveling isn't cheap. They had a travel pak available where you can buy 6 one-way coupons for $429. So with the coupons.. my family could fly to a neighbor island for just under $1000. Well my hubby's grandmother recently passed away, and after securing our place to stay and transportation.. Last thing was our flights.. So once we had the money for sure.. I went online to book our tickets. Signed into my Island Miles account.. and went to purchase the Travel Pak. Input my account information just to get booted off the page saying "the travel paks were no longer available" I tried again because of course it is the cheapest way for us to travel.. same message.. so I had no choice but to do it individually. I went through it all and summed up the total price. Next.. I went online to check my bank to ensure there was enough money seeing it was more expensive booking it that way... ISLAND AIR CHARGED MY ACCOUNT $877!! AND ADDITIONALLY $439!! I called the customer service and the representative took down my name my account number the authorization codes for the charges, reassured me she would fax my bank for a stop payment. My hubby called towards the end of the work day, and she did nothing for our situation. Her name was Mereleisa. In that phone call five ours later she "PUT IN A REQUEST TO REVERSE THE CHARGES" faxed my bank.. wrote up a letter to email me. FAST FORWARD- Today is three days later.. they have pulled t
reviews.author: Mahealani K

reviews.title: on time,  efficient service
reviews.text: I did not expect much of this budget airline, but they just did what they had to do, fly us to and from Lihue to Honolulu. Both flights were in time. Check-in efficient, although the weighing of the hand luggage is a bit of joke. Flights were empty so service on board was quick. I did not expect any service anyway, but cookie was nice and a choice of juice and water. Airline hostesses were friendly. Both touch downs were a bit rough. I would certainly book them again.
reviews.author: Bea T

reviews.title: Professional check in, on time departure and arrival
reviews.text: Check in desk was helpful and patient when one suitcase was over weight, they suggested we just rearrange and place items in underweight case and weighed the suitcase until it met weight limit. Flight departed on time and arrived early.
reviews.author: KLE2013

reviews.title: Expected more
reviews.text: At the start of the flight, they announce that the plane is small and that they were looking for volunteers to check in their carry-ons. Several people volunteered to do so. I was 3rd or 4th in line and my check-in bag weighed about 10 lbs (very light, used for souvenirs and snacks); immediately the man checking my ticket asked if I'd like to check it in "at no cost". I told him it was light and preferred it with me. He rolled his eyes and then ushered me along. Then, as I continued outside to the plane, a lady insisted I check it in. When I asked why, she said it was because there wasn't enough room on the plane. I told her I understood that, but since I'm at the start of the line, it seems that they would wait until other guests came on to reevaluate space, and then take carry-ons at that point. And also, I didn't volunteer to check it in. She grabbed my bag and said that it would be waiting for me once we landed, and tried to "dummy" it down for me. When we seated, I waited and witnessed at least 10 other people who were allowed to bring their carry-ons on, some much heavier and hard to lift. Of course, all those people looked like locals, so it doesn't surprise me...while I've (generally speaking) been treated fairly in Hawaii, there are times like that prove outside opinion that Hawaiian's discriminate. There ended up being plenty of space onboard, so I'm still confused by this logic. Irritating because if I needed stuff from that bag, I'd have to pull it out and reorgan
reviews.author: MICHELLE P

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: Worst airline ever!!!:( Lies to people to the face. Pushes every flight 2 hours or more by saying there is a maintenance problem when the flight have not even arrived. So obvious that they Are lying. They shouldn't be booking flights if they cannot handle it. Did some research and only has 7 flights and they over book and make money they shouldn't be making. Robbing people in front of their face. I will be complaining to the DOT about this airline.
reviews.author: Nparys
